note: Comparison domains of the Wave 5 manifest, declared before the run (incremental-delivery ADR §5). qualify:wave5 records this file and its digest in the manifest before it runs any suite; a change to it is a reviewed change, never a step of a run.

domains.rule: The commit identity is compared exactly; a dirty tree is a deviation of the candidate.
Each version is a sha256 over its tracked source files' paths and bytes, in path order, plus the literal version strings read from them.
A suite passes when its command exits 0. The log digest identifies the log retained beside the manifest; its text is not compared across runs.
Each cited marker is a literal span of its file on the candidate, found unchanged; the row's result is its suites' result.
The scripted reports' accuracy and counts are recorded as they are; scripted models are deterministic fixtures and never stand for a real provider.
Counts and distributions are measured on this candidate and host only. Unknown cost and tokens stay unknown and are counted, never read as zero.
Wall-clock times, durations, host paths and the run directory are incidental and excluded from comparison.
